Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Luke Kornet?

Luke Kornet is 31 years old.

Where was Luke Kornet born?

Luke Kornet was born in Lantana, Texas.

When was Luke Kornet born?

Luke Kornet was born on July 15, 1995.

How tall is Luke Kornet?

Luke Kornet is 7-1 (216 cm) tall.

How much does Luke Kornet weigh?

Luke Kornet weighs 250 lbs (113 kg).

Is Luke Kornet in the Hall of Fame?

Luke Kornet is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does Luke Kornet play?

Center.

What is Luke Kornet's net worth?

Luke Kornet has made at least $24,565,725 playing professional basketball.

How much does Luke Kornet make?

Luke Kornet made $11,000,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Luke Kornet have?

Luke Kornet has won one championship.

What schools did Luke Kornet attend?

Luke Kornet attended Liberty Christian in Argyle, Texas and Vanderbilt.

What are Luke Kornet's nicknames?

The Green Kornet, UniKornet, Korn on the Lob, The Big Elote are nicknames for Luke Kornet.
